description: Four-channel mixer for audio or CV in 4HP, split into two pairs that cascade into one master

params.text: Sets the level of that channel in the mix, from silence to unity gain

inputs.text: A signal into the mix, scaled by that channel's gain knob

outputs.text: Channels 1 and 2 added together; with no cable here that pair is passed on to the 3+4 output instead
Channels 3 and 4 added together, with channels 1 and 2 added in as well when the 1+2 output has no cable

menu: Clip outputs at ±10V — holds both outputs inside -10V to 10V; off by default, and found on the Hardware compatibility submenu
